purpose: Teach: ヒデ/オト/ヨハネ/チャールズ/アラン/エホバ/トーマス/ケリー

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、X JAPANのヒデにハマってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were obsessed with X Japan's Hide, weren't you?
lines.style: Playful jab with real curiosity underneath. Sharp opening. Light mischief in the tone — not mean, just testing. Quick pace, knowing smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ペットのオトくんって名前可愛いな、桜
lines.en: You named your pet Oto? That's actually cute, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry deflection with the faintest warmth breaking through. Half-laugh at the end. Turns the observation back on her — a small, genuine compliment wrapped in wryness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で聖ヨハネ教会習ったろ
lines.en: Riku, didn't you study the Church of Saint John in social studies?
lines.style: Catching-you-out tone. Leans into the specificity like she's got you. Amused, slightly conspiratorial. Raises the energy just enough to say: I've been paying attention.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、英王室のチャールズ国王知ってるよな、桜
lines.en: You know about King Charles and the British royal family, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. Turns it back on her without heat. The tone of someone who notices she notices things. Even pace, slight lift on her name — acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、映画でアラン・リックマン見たろ
lines.en: Riku, you watched Alan Rickman in movies, didn't you?
lines.style: Quick, casual strike. Testing if he'll remember. Bright curiosity — not accusation. The pace picks up slightly, like she's enjoying the back-and-forth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でエホバの証人について調べてたな、桜
lines.en: You looked up Jehovah's Witnesses for a social studies project, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Even-toned, factual. No smugness. Just reflecting back what he's noticed about her. Slight pause before her name — giving her space to feel seen.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、機関車トーマスのフィギュア持ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you had Thomas the Tank Engine figurines, didn't you?
lines.style: Teasing with real affection underneath. The smile's in the voice. Soft, not cutting. Knows this will land — knows he cares about it, knows he might be embarrassed, doesn't push.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ニュースでケリー長官の名前覚えたろ、桜
lines.en: You learned Kerry's name from the news, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet, observant closing. Gentle precision — not correcting, just mirroring back something small and true about her. Warm, no performance. Slight intimacy in knowing this detail.
